prompts.name: walk_sword
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production 2D game animation sprite sheet, transparent RGBA.
Input image 1: identity, costume, proportions, palette and weapon reference ONLY. Ignore its labels, panels and background. Make new clean full-body animation artwork of exactly the same black long straight-haired schoolgirl.

Primary request: eight consecutive frames of a WALK CYCLE with a small straight sword in her near hand, facing RIGHT in exact 90-degree side profile throughout. 4 columns by 2 rows, exactly EIGHT separate full-body sprites, reading order left to right then next row. Intended canvas 2048 by 1024. Equal invisible cells; one character per cell. Every complete character and sword contained inside its cell with generous transparent gutters. No frames, gridlines, numbers, text, floor, shadow or background; genuine transparent alpha.

Identity: oversized rounded anime chibi head, one large violet eye visible, small profile nose, sleek long BLACK straight hair down to waist, straight bangs, white collared blouse with long sleeves and tiny navy ribbon, dark navy pleated knee-above skirt, dark knee socks and brown loafers. Match the reference face and colors, clean high-quality hand-drawn cel-shaded game art; do not make pixel art. Character about 2.7 heads high. Exactly same head size, clothes, sword, body proportions and lighting in all eight frames. Sharp dark outline, controlled lavender shadows.

Pose sequence: 1 near leg forward heel contact, far leg behind toe contact; 2 weight settles on near foot with slightly bent knee; 3 passing, far knee swings forward, near foot under hip; 4 high point, far leg extends forward; 5 far leg heel contact forward, near leg behind; 6 settle onto far foot; 7 passing with near knee forward; 8 near leg extends into the next contact. Feet articulate with heel-to-toe roll, hips bob subtly, hair and skirt lag gently. A calm WALK, not a run. Character walks in place, side view never changes. Hold sword consistently down-forward away from the face in the near hand; far arm counter-swings naturally. Do not duplicate the same pose eight times. Body root centered horizontally at same coordinate within every cell, same ground baseline, with intentional small hip bob only. No disembodied parts, extra limbs, detached fingers or dropped weapon.

prompts.prompt:

No glow, shadow, floor, checkerboard, text or other additions. Keep clean antialiased character edges.

Each sprite occupies about 85% of cell height, ample transparent margins for sword, full hair and both shoes. Do not copy the walk poses; all eight are standing.

prompts.name: jump_sword
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent RGBA sprite animation sheet.
Input image 1: exact identity, clothing, linework, colors, sword and proportions reference; ignore its background residue. Create EIGHT new full-body JUMP poses of this SAME girl, strictly right-facing side view, 4 columns by 2 rows in reading order. Same cell layout/scale as reference. No labels, borders, grids, effects, floor, shadows or backgrounds; genuine native alpha transparency with clean edges.
Black long straight-haired chibi girl, big rounded head with violet near eye, tiny profile nose, white collared long-sleeve blouse and little navy ribbon, navy pleated skirt, knee socks and brown loafers, small silver straight sword securely in near hand pointing safely forward/down away from her face. Keep identity and anatomy consistent and opaque in every frame; crisp cel art, not pixel art.
Frame 1 standing preparation, slight knee bend.
2 deep but modest knee bend, hips lower, torso leans forward a little, ready to push off.
3 strong upward takeoff, legs extending, heels lifting.
4 ascending, knees bend back under her, hair tips trail downward.
5 apex, knees tucked naturally and sword held forward, hair floats slightly.
6 falling, feet extend toward landing, hair tips lift slightly.
7 landing absorption, knees flex and torso leans, both feet back on ground.
8 upright recovery matching start.
These are actual different whole-body poses, with continuous natural movement, no extra limbs. No underwear visible at any time; skirt preserves modest coverage.
Keep head SIZE fixed, not head position: body crouches and stretches naturally. Root horizontally centered per cell; don't draw the jump's world-space travel across the sheet, only local poses. Room for entire sword, hair and shoes inside every cell. No cropped feet and no overlap between cells.

prompts.name: slash
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent RGBA combat animation sheet.
Image 1 is exact identity, style, outfit, sword and character scale reference, not a layout to copy poses from. Create EIGHT new sequential SWORD ATTACK sprites in a 4-column 2-row grid. Identical character in strict right-facing side view. True transparent background, no grid, numbers, labels, floor, shadow or surrounding haze.
Original black long straight-haired chibi girl, rounded oversized head, violet near eye, white collared blouse with long sleeves and navy ribbon, dark pleated skirt, dark knee socks, brown loafers, short silver straight sword. Keep head SIZE, eye design, hair length, limb lengths, colors and weapon design identical in every frame. Clean finished cel-shaded linework.
A single decisive downward-forward sword slash with a readable full-body arc. Poses in reading order:
1 ready: sword diagonally up-forward in near hand, relaxed knees.
2 anticipation: raise sword above and slightly behind shoulder, elbow flexed; torso leans back slightly, knees load.
3 high windup: sword hand above forehead, blade sweeps back overhead, clear of head; body turned only within true side profile.
4 fast downswing: hand and sword sweep forward in front of the face without penetrating it; torso and weight drive forward. One narrow subtle pale teal motion arc may trace sword tip.
5 impact: arm extends diagonally down-forward, sword tip forward at waist height, lead knee bent, rear heel lifts; clean silhouette.
6 follow-through: sword low-forward past the target, hips and hair trail.
7 recover: return sword toward guard, knees straighten.
8 ready nearly matching frame1 for smooth return.
Correct gripping hand around hilt in every pose, no detached sword, no backwards wrist or broken elbow. Both shoes stay within the same local ground baseline except natural heel lift. Character root at same x per cell; do not walk across frame. Whole sword arc and hair contained in each cell; use generous empty margins. Hair/skirt follow movement subtly, no extra limbs or exaggerated effects.

prompts.name: bow_draw
prompts.prompt:

Create eight consecutive full-body BOW DRAW frames in 4 columns by 2 rows, equal invisible cells, strict RIGHT-FACING 90-degree side view. Same black long straight-haired chibi schoolgirl with large rounded head, violet near eye, white long-sleeve collared blouse and tiny navy ribbon, dark pleated skirt, knee socks and brown loafers. All frames have identical facial design, head size, clothing, colors and weapon. No sword.
A slender dark purple recurve bow is held in the forward hand ahead of her face. One arrow is nocked horizontally at shoulder/chin height, pointing RIGHT through the bow grip. Forward arm supports the bow, rear hand pulls the bowstring toward the cheek. Near and far arm overlap anatomically, fingertips really contact the string, no floating arrow or detached hand.
Sequence: 1 relaxed archery ready with arrow nocked, bow slightly forward and string nearly relaxed; 2 raise and settle bow to shooting line; 3 draw string a quarter; 4 draw halfway; 5 draw three-quarters; 6 draw almost full; 7 anchor the fingers by cheek with rear elbow back; 8 full draw held steadily, same stable feet and torso. Keep face visible, bow entirely ahead of face, arrow horizontal, no exaggerated twisting. Feet shoulder-width at a consistent ground line, minimal body movement, hair settles subtly.
Full sprites including complete bow limbs and arrow fit comfortably in each cell, do not crop or overlap adjacent cells. Crisp clean opaque cel-shaded character silhouettes, antialiased edges. Genuine native alpha transparent backdrop, no haze or halo or colored residue, no shadows, ground, labels, numbers, grids or background.
